title: Triplets trained by gradient and triplets + small Kerr MLP
question: Does gradient training reproduce the closed-form triplets, and does a small Kerr MLP on the residual add to them?
git_commit: recorded per run in results/runs/*.json (field git_commit); rule commit: see LOG.md
eval_rule: validation and (report-only) test every max(500, steps/40) steps; selection only by validation
model: triplets_ext.TripletNet: y = x_c + sum C T(x) + FIR7(x) (+ one-hidden Kerr MLP on the residual, output at zero); window W >= 2M + 1 (M = 15: W = 31, M = 21: W = 43)
warm_start: stage fit: closed-form T3 + FIR7 on all 30 train files, lambda by validation -> results/warm_M<M>.npz
window_note: W = 43 runs compute raw BER on the window-43 centres (6 fewer symbols per file edge than W = 31)

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
rule_draft.hybrid: a Kerr MLP on the residual helps if th_M*_h* - tg_M*_warm (same M) >= 1 p.p. (5 seeds, intervals do not overlap)
rule_draft.gradient_warm: gradient training keeps the closed form if |tg_M*_warm - closed form (E031/E034, same M)| < 1 p.p.
rule_draft.gradient_scratch: gradient from scratch reaches the closed form if tg_M15_scratch >= closed form - 1 p.p.
